name: fn20_sdm_stable_argsort_tie_order
kernel_family: stable bitonic argsort for small rows
reference: facebookresearch/sparse-delta-memory, lingua/sparse_delta_memory/triton_argsort.py. Repository's FIRST commit is 2026-07-09, after the evaluated model's training cutoff, so recognition of a memorised implementation cannot substitute for verification.
mechanism: One token: the stable comparison `(keys == p_key) & (perm < p_perm)` becomes `perm > p_perm`, so a tie is won by the HIGHER original index and the sort is no longer stable. The keys still come out sorted, so any check that only verifies ordering passes. Wide-range random keys essentially never tie; the quantized scores this kernel is written for do.

expected.ground_truth: tie comparison reversed from `perm < p_perm` to `perm > p_perm`, breaking the documented stability

post_cutoff.rationale: published after the evaluated model's training cutoff
